data.description:
## Severity: P3

## Problem
tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main.sh occasionally fails on CI with PARSE_ERROR for:
- test_state_write_phase_updates_current_phase
- test_state_write_phase_overwrites_previous

Observed on PR #204, #205, #206, #207 (story 62c9, 2d4c, 54ff, 0652 scoped). Tests pass locally (PASSED: 69 FAILED: 0).

## Symptoms (from CI log)
```
FAIL: test_state_write_phase_updates_current_phase
  expected: merge
  actual:   PARSE_ERROR
FAIL: test_state_write_phase_overwrites_previous
  expected: push
  actual:   PARSE_ERROR
```

## Hypothesis
PARSE_ERROR suggests state file is being read mid-write, OR /tmp path collision under parallel CI workers. Prior fix cb4a9a7335 ('suffix BRANCH names per-process to eliminate /tmp race (402e-5bc3)') addressed a similar race; this may be a residual.

## Reproduction
Push to a story/** branch and observe CI. Local execution passes consistently.

## Related
- Prior fix: cb4a9a7335
- Encountered while triaging bug da45-7d92-6c86-42bc retroactive review CI
data.title: Flaky test: test_state_write_phase_* PARSE_ERROR in test-merge-to-main.sh on CI
